Martyna Kubka (born 19 April 2001) is a Polish tennis player. She has a career-high WTA ranking of 305 in singles, achieved on 22 July 2024, and a career-high WTA ranking of 123 in doubles, achieved on 21 April 2025. [ 1 ] Career [ edit ] Kubka made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2021 WTA Poland Open in the doubles competition. [ citation needed ] Her singles tour-level debut was at the 2022 Poland Open , losing to Elisabetta Cocciaretto in the first round. [ 2 ] Kubka made her debut for Poland in the Billie Jean King Cup in November 2023 playing doubles in the Finals . [ 3 ] Partnering Weronika Falkowska , she won the doubles title at the 2024 WTA 125 Poland Open , defeating Céline Naef and Nina Stojanović in the final.
